root_cause: render_analyzed_image (yomu/ocr/ocr_balloon.py) produces BOTH the clean page and the typeset page in one pass: `inpainted` is the text-removed art (captured as capture['cleaned_bgr']), and `final` is `inpainted` + redrawn translated glyphs. The pipeline then writes `final` -> output_path (translated working file) and `cleaned_bgr` -> *_cleaned.png (clean working file) from that single call, and the whole finalize tail (persist, PDF, manifest, return) assumes a typeset page exists. There is no way to run clean without the typeset machinery, and no way to run translate without rendering.

ocr_reuse: OCR/grouping run before the translation barrier (process_pre_translation) and are shared by clean and typeset. No OCR duplication is introduced by splitting render; translate-only and traducao_clean reuse the same detected regions.
clean_duplication_risk: render cleans once into `inpainted`; typeset draws on top of the SAME inpainted buffer. Splitting (typeset flag) does not re-clean. clean+typeset = 1 clean, 0 duplicate.
yk_provider_coupling: provider boundary + YK commit are BEFORE render (2515-2636), gated by translation_enabled. Render has no provider calls except layout-overflow retries, which are already closed at settlement. So clean-only (translation off) = 0 provider/0 YK regardless of render; typeset-off removes even the overflow-retry typeset work.
